auditMetadata.title: MBC Creator Phase 4 Full End-to-End Construction & Launch Preparation Audit
auditMetadata.auditArtifactsState: Reconciled and updated against authoritative source
auditMetadata.phaseScope: Step 4.1 through Step 4.9 (Creator Journey Phase 1 to Phase 5 scope)
auditMetadata.verdict: Verified within tested scope — zero blocking application defects; pricing evidence classification corrected

stepAudits.name: Construction Snapshot
stepAudits.figmaNode: Not verified (canonical root reference without explicit node ID)
stepAudits.keyFindings: Reads actual project needs, resources, and evidence; does not introduce competing numeric scores; explains findings through source lineage.

stepAudits.name: Operational Roadmap
stepAudits.keyFindings: Enforces 6 canonical persisted stages (NOW, NEXT_30_DAYS, DAYS_30_TO_60, DAYS_60_TO_90, BEFORE_LAUNCH, POST_LAUNCH) matching OperationalRoadmapModels.cs and STAGE_CONFIG; preserves task IDs, completion states, and effort estimates across regeneration; handles dependencies without fabricated delivery dates.

stepAudits.name: Needs & Requirements
stepAudits.keyFindings: Distinguishes system findings from founder decisions (Confirmed/Deferred); optional requirements do not act as universal blockers.

stepAudits.name: Skills & Training
stepAudits.keyFindings: Separates Learn/Delegate/Verify recommendations from founder decisions; enforces delegation as an unresolved delivery dependency until hired/delivered.

stepAudits.name: Aids, Grants & Support
stepAudits.keyFindings: Distinguishes 'Eligible to apply' from awarded capital; potential support is not added to spendable budget.

stepAudits.name: Pricing & Revenue Model
stepAudits.keyFindings: Consistently models 4 distinct pricing fields (RecommendedPrice, FounderPrice, MarketReferencePrice, ValidatedMarketPrice) plus effective Price; PricingPolicyEngine treats only confirmed paid sales/pilots (HistoricalSale, PaidPilot) with confirmed Price > 0 and EmpiricallyValidated level as empirical proof of market price; quote accepted and preorders without proof of payment act as reference/indicative evidence; founder-reported paid sales/preorders remain Supported with IsFounderReported=true; filtering precedes record selection so an invalid first record cannot hide later qualifying evidence.

stepAudits.name: GTM & Launch Strategy
stepAudits.keyFindings: Sales motion adapts to buyer complexity; activation executes via PATCH /api/creator/phase4/gtm setting Status='Active', PlanActivated='true', and ActivatedAt timestamp; preserves founder overrides and budget status (Unknown vs Confirmed Zero).

stepAudits.name: Launch Assets
stepAudits.keyFindings: Synthesizes BrandKit/Pricing/GTM; Sections['pricing'].IsIncluded is authoritative; immutable public share snapshots via GET /api/creator/phase4/assets/public/{shareToken} ([AllowAnonymous]); source export produces standalone HTML with embedded styles and logo assets; external Google Fonts require internet access, with fallback fonts available.

stepAudits.name: Construction Readiness
stepAudits.keyFindings: 7 canonical sections; nullable score discipline ('Score not yet calculated'); honest next-action task binding with no synthetic IDs or fabricated effort; saving review via POST /api/creator/phase4/readiness/save performs SHA-256 SourceFingerprint check and records founder readiness assessment.

reconciledFindings.subject: Step 4.6 Pricing Evidence Qualification & Predicate Filter
reconciledFindings.description: Corrected PricingPolicyEngine.cs:235-255 and PricingStrategyService.cs:226-253. PricingPolicyEngine strictly requires HistoricalSale/PaidPilot with Price > 0 and EmpiricallyValidated level for empirical validation; QuoteAccepted and PreOrder without proof of payment are routed to MarketReferencePrice (Supported/Indicative). PricingStrategyService filters qualifying evidence across all recorded items using LastOrDefault(r => r.IsPaid && (r.Type == PreOrder || r.Type == Sale) && r.Amount > 0), ensuring invalid/unpaid earlier records do not mask subsequent qualifying records, and preserves IsFounderReported=true provenance and Supported validation level across refreshes.
reconciledFindings.status: Applied and verified with 51/51 passing pricing unit tests

reconciledFindings.subject: Step 4.2 Roadmap Canonical Stages
reconciledFindings.description: Previous audit incorrectly described a 3-stage Now/Next/Later pipeline. OperationalRoadmapModels.cs:6-35 and OperationalRoadmapView.tsx:60-103 define exactly 6 persisted canonical stages: NOW, NEXT_30_DAYS, DAYS_30_TO_60, DAYS_60_TO_90, BEFORE_LAUNCH, and POST_LAUNCH.

reconciledFindings.subject: Step 4.7 GTM Activation Endpoint & Contract
reconciledFindings.description: Previous audit described a POST /activate endpoint with IsActive boolean. Verified backend controller and API client use PATCH /api/creator/phase4/gtm with { status: 'Active', founderOverrides: { PlanActivated: 'true' } }, setting Strategy.Status = 'Active' and recording ActivatedAt timestamp.

reconciledFindings.subject: Step 4.8 Launch Assets Download Format & Dependencies
reconciledFindings.description: Verified controller action GetSourceCode and client handler handleDownloadSource deliver a standalone HTML file named [safeSlug]-launch-page-v[version].html (Content-Type text/html). BuildStandaloneHtml embeds styles and base64 logo assets inline; external Google Fonts require internet access, with system fallback fonts available in CSS.

reconciledFindings.subject: Controller Endpoint Inventory Reconciliation
reconciledFindings.description: Reconciled controller endpoint inventory: CreatorPhase4ConstructionController contains exactly 47 endpoints (45 authenticated endpoints under [Authorize] and 2 public endpoints with [AllowAnonymous]: GET assets/public/{shareToken} and GET assets/public/{shareToken}/html). All 47 endpoints are fully enumerated in the API contract table.

reconciledFindings.subject: Concurrency & Rollback Mechanism Scope
reconciledFindings.description: Previous audit claimed every mutation uses SHA-256 fingerprint validation and atomic transaction rollbacks. Verified source uses MongoDB conditional updates (Builders.Filter.Eq(x => x.Version, expectedVersion)) in CreatorIdeaRepository.cs:133-155. If version conflicts occur, MatchedCount is 0 (no write occurs, 409 thrown). SHA-256 SourceFingerprint validation is exclusively implemented in Step 4.9 Construction Readiness Save.

reconciledFindings.subject: Sold / Read-Only Status Error Code Mapping
reconciledFindings.description: Previous documentation had conflicting references to HTTP 422 vs HTTP 403 for sold project mutations. Verified CreatorPhase4ConstructionController catches InvalidOperationException from sold-idea checks (ResolveIdeaAsync) and returns StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden.

reconciledFindings.subject: Product Scope & Readiness Save Scope
reconciledFindings.description: Removed unsupported Phase 6 mentions (Creator journey scope is Phase 1 to Phase 5). Clarified that Step 4.9 OverallScore is a nullable domain model field currently returning null ('Score not yet calculated') pending formal algorithmic policy, and saving a readiness review records the review state rather than completing unfinished project construction tasks.
